create_dataframe_plot_bar: create a polars DataFrame and draw a bar plot with x, y, and color columns using df.plot.bar
create_dataframe_plot_line: create a polars DataFrame and draw a line plot with x, y, color, and order columns using df.plot.line
create_dataframe_plot_point: create a polars DataFrame and draw a scatter plot with x, y, color, and size columns using df.plot.point
create_dataframe_plot_scatter: create a polars DataFrame and draw a scatter plot using df.plot.scatter as an alias for df.plot.point
create_dataframe_plot_custom: create a polars DataFrame and draw a custom Altair chart using df.plot with any mark_* method via __getattr__
